claim: America went from 75,000 flu deaths last year in 2019 to almost 0 in 2020

gold.justification: There were an estimated 21,909 flu deaths during the 2019-2020 flu season, not 75,000. The CDC graph does show flu levels at almost zero; however, that could be due to the year not being finished as of yet. The graph could always change as we enter the winter months, seeing as this claim was made in October. Hence, there is some conflicting evidence here.
